Resolves #19149

`Neo.calendar.view.month.Component#construct` decided whether to build its grid from two store counts:

```js
if (me.calendarStore.getCount() > 0 && me.eventStore.getCount() > 0) {
    me.needsEventUpdate = true
}

me.needsEventUpdate && me.createContent(true);
```

`afterSetMounted` builds only behind that same flag, so a month with no calendars never reached `createContent` at all. Measured against a live server on `dev` at `18b473b6e8`:

```text
after mount      weeks 0   days 0   events 0
addCalendar      weeks 0   days 0
addEvent         weeks 18  days 126 events 1
```

The first two lines are the defect; the third shows the same component drawing correctly as soon as a matched calendar/event pair arrives through `onEventStoreLoad`. The defect is in the mount path.

The days are the grid's frame, so they no longer wait on data: `construct` builds them unconditionally. Events keep needing their calendars, because `createContent` calls `createWeek` per row and `createWeek` reads each event's calendar for its color class. `Store#get` answers `null` for a missing key, so an event whose calendar is absent is skipped instead of throwing on that read.

The #2460 race is untouched. That fix made a view constructed *after* both stores loaded build its events; it still does, through `onEventStoreLoad`.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium, the component tier locally and in CI) → L3 required (the product-witness ACs). No residuals.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | arm 1 of the spec below: 18 weeks and 126 day cells with both stores empty |
| AC-2 | arm 4's `expect.poll` on the day count after `addCalendar` and before `addEvent`: the calendar-only state already draws its days |
| AC-3 | arm 4: the matched event lands in `#calendar-month-view__day__2027-02-10` with its title |
| AC-4 | arm 3: the orphan event is not drawn, and the rebuild that carries it does not throw |
| AC-5 | `test/playwright/component/calendar/MonthEmptyMount.spec.mjs`, on fixture `component/apps/calendar-month/` |
| AC-6 | CI on `cad3d0ce77`: all three `components` shards, `unit` and `unit-tz` pass |

## Deltas from ticket
- The guard's read is reachable on `dev` today whenever the calendar store loads while an event's calendar is missing from it: `onCalendarStoreLoad` rebuilds through `createWeek` and reads `.active` on `null`, throwing `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'active')`. The reverted-source run below throws there, so the guard fixes an existing crash as well as covering the zero-calendar month this fix opens. Arm 3 exercises that load path.
- Arm 3 needed a second store write to reach the guard: the orphan write alone never rebuilds, because `onEventStoreLoad` returns while the calendar store is empty. The `addCalendar` write is the rebuild that reaches the read.
- Row counts are derived, not copied: `createContent` renders 18 weeks of 7 days, the continuous scrolling month rather than a calendar's 5 or 6 rows. The month view never calls `getWeeksOfMonth`.
- The `calendar-month` fixture the ticket refers to as mine was never committed; `git log --all --diff-filter=A` over that path returns nothing. It is built here rather than recovered.

## Test Evidence
`test/playwright/component/calendar/MonthEmptyMount.spec.mjs`, four arms. The fixture names the month child so the counts belong to that view alone, and `driver.mjs` seeds the stores from inside the App Worker, because they live beside the component and `page.evaluate` cannot reach them.

| arm | red on `dev`, spec unchanged | at this head |
|---|---|---|
| 1. no calendars, no events | `Expected: 18 / Received: 0` weeks | 18 weeks, 126 cells |
| 2. the 1st of the fixture month | `Expected: 126 / Received: 0` cells | its cell is attached |
| 3. an orphan event does not reach a day cell | the `addCalendar` write reports failure, with the `TypeError` in the worker | `0` events, days still drawn |
| 4. a matched pair still reaches its cell | `Expected: 126 / Received: 0` cells at the calendar-only poll | the event is in its cell, with its title |

- The guard's own red, mutation-style: on this head with only the guard reverted (`if (calendarRecord.active)`), arm 3 fails with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'active')` at `month/Component.mjs:537`, reached through `onCalendarStoreLoad` into `createContent` and `createWeek`; the other three arms pass. That is the failure the guard owns.
- Green: 4 passed on `cad3d0ce77`.

- Full local component tier on `cad3d0ce77`: 402 passed, 5 failed. The five sit in `component/`, `dashboard/` and `tab/`, none of them touches `calendar/`, and this spec's four arms passed within the same run. CI then ran the same tier on this head across three shards, and all passed.

## Post-Merge Validation
- Nothing owed: every AC is witnessed before merge.

## Commits
- `e2ecb88d7a`: the mount build and the guard
- `cad3d0ce77`: the witness reaches the guard, and the guard takes the week view's `?.` form
